draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Leo,

I know launch weeks get busy, so no worries if Wrenfield has been on the back burner. You've already got an invite out to a teammate, which is a good start -- the next piece is your first project, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and teammates can be invited any time from Account Settings -> Members.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through it with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Priya
